question: How does visarga give rise to the world and its agitation?
premises: That very power is identified as visarga.
From that visarga this world is born.
Its capacity for agitation is the arising of the stir of agitation.
inference: Visarga is the source of the world and of the agitation that unfolds within it.
plain_english: That very power is visarga, and from it this world is born. Its capacity for agitation is the arising of the stir of agitation.
